New • Notification pace: pick Instant, Balanced or Relaxed in Settings > General to set how often Actvt interrupts you. Relaxed suits agents running in loops • Repeats from one project are grouped. The first arrives as usual, the rest come back as one summary, so a scheduled re-run no longer floods Notification Center • Mute a project from the notification itself, for an hour or a day. Muted projects are listed in Settings with the time left, and every mute expires on its own • Notifications now say what the agent needs: the tool it wants permission to run, or the question it ended on • Agents can notify you themselves. Any agent on Actvt's MCP server can say in its own words why it stopped, and Actvt's own detection stays as a backstop. Free on every tier • Agents on your other machines can notify you too. Run actvt-cli notify from a session on any remote host and the message reaches your Mac on the next sync, with the same mutes and grouping as everything else. Update actvt-cli on each host to enable it • Remote quiet time is yours to set: how long a session on another machine must pause before Actvt calls it stopped
Improved • Your license keeps working for up to 30 days offline and re-verifies in the background, so a trip, a flaky connection or a server outage can't lock you out • AI PII detection is now labelled Experimental in Settings, so it is clear that its accuracy is still being tuned. The regex detection it builds on is unchanged • Notification text is masked for personal data, and macOS hides it entirely when previews are off • Claude usage now shows your per-model limits again, including Fable, and names your plan (Max 20x, Pro) on the usage card • If you use pay-as-you-go credits, Claude usage now shows what you have spent against your monthly cap. This is money actually billed, and it is labelled to keep it apart from the API-rate estimates • Cost figures now say they are API rates, and when Actvt can see you are on a Pro, Max or Plus plan it says so and explains that the number is not your bill, just what those tokens would cost on the API • Cost estimates cover the latest models, including Claude Opus 5 • Sessions on a model with no published pricing are counted and labelled, so an unpriced session isn't mistaken for a free one • Freeing a port from Monitor runs a countdown you can cancel, and it keeps running while you scroll
Fixed • Actvt no longer asks you to re-enter your license key after a stretch offline • A license with no expiry now reads "Never expires" instead of a date decades away, and activating one no longer fails with a decode error • Running out of activations says so, instead of reporting a rate limit • The license window no longer lists features that don't exist, and now credits Basic with its 30 days of session history • Pricing data syncs again, so cost estimates stay current

New • Remote Sessions (Basic and Premium): see your agent sessions on other machines over SSH, including headless Linux boxes. Enable in Settings > Agents and install the CLI on each host with one command; Tailscale machines are discovered automatically • Read remote transcripts on demand, resume any remote session in one click, and browse every machine in one merged timeline. Remote data stays in memory and never touches your local index • Notifications: get told when a session is waiting for your input, finishes, or errors. Optional alerts cover long-running sessions, cost thresholds, error bursts, and thermal pressure • Click a session notification (or use the session view) to jump straight to the terminal or editor window it runs in • Keyboard shortcuts: press the hotkey prefix (default Option+T), then a key to jump anywhere in the app. Customize in Settings > General • Usage bars: your Claude and Codex plan limits in the Overview, with reset countdowns and a notification when a used-up limit resets • Overview time ranges: view your agent activity for the last 7, 30, or 90 days, or all time
Improved • The Basic tier now includes 30 days of agent session history (free covers the last 72 hours; Premium keeps unlimited history) • Live status is backed by the real process state, so a session waiting for input reads differently from one that is streaming, and killed sessions drop their live dot within seconds • Sessions show where they started (CLI, desktop app, or IDE) and can be filtered by it. Claude Desktop sessions are now tracked alongside Claude Code and Codex • The hotkey settings now tell you when the helper is missing Accessibility permission, with a shortcut to System Settings
Fixed • Fixed a crash at launch on macOS 26.5 • Fixed a crash at launch that could occur when the same agent session exists in two project folders (for example after a project folder was moved or copied) • Keyboard shortcuts no longer break after an app update: Actvt now restarts its helper automatically when it is outdated, no logout needed • A brief server outage can no longer deactivate your license. Actvt keeps it and recovers on the next successful check • Session timestamps no longer show "in 0 sec." right after an update

This release fixes a crash at launch in 1.1.3 and carries everything new from that version. If Actvt crashes immediately after updating, download this version manually from actvt.io
